target.title: test(shared): add unit tests for config path array index parser
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `parseConfigPathArrayIndex` utility in `src/shared/path-array-index.ts` has no dedicated unit tests, leaving the path array index validation unverified against regressions.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds comprehensive unit test coverage for the config path array index parser, covering:
- Valid indices (0, positive integers up to max bound)
- Empty strings
- Negative numbers
- Leading zeros (rejected per canonical format)
- Non-numeric strings
- Floats (rejected)
- Whitespace
- Max bound exceeding (100001 → undefined)
- Max allowed index (100000 → valid)
- Unsafe integer rejection

## User Impact

- Purely additive: one new test file, no production code changes
- No risk of breaking existing behavior

## Evidence

- 11/11 tests pass locally
- All tests are deterministic with no external dependencies
